
# Load brain size (TBV) from FreeSurfer and behavioral data
```{r}
cortical_vol <- read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/FreeSurfer/FreeSurfer_Output_ABIDE.csv')
behaviourals_all$BrainSeg <- cortical_vol$BrainSegVolNotVent[
  match(behaviourals_all$SUB_ID, as.character(cortical_vol$SUB_ID))
]
stopifnot(!any(is.na(behaviourals_all$BrainSeg)))

# ASD data (imputed) and matching subject courses
subject_courses_tp_ids <- data.frame(SUB_ID = behaviourals_all$SUB_ID, subject_courses_tp)
behaviourals_ASD <- read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Imputation/imputed_data_final_FSL.csv')
behaviourals_ASD$SUB_ID <- as.character(as.integer(behaviourals_ASD$SUB_ID))

subject_courses_ASD <- subject_courses_tp_ids[match(behaviourals_ASD$SUB_ID, subject_courses_tp_ids$SUB_ID), ]
cat("IDs in same order?", all(subject_courses_ASD$SUB_ID == behaviourals_ASD$SUB_ID), "\n")
subject_courses_ASD_matrix <- as.matrix(subject_courses_ASD[, -1])

behaviourals_ASD$BrainSeg <- behaviourals_all$BrainSeg[match(behaviourals_ASD$SUB_ID, behaviourals_all$SUB_ID)]
stopifnot(!any(is.na(behaviourals_ASD$BrainSeg)))
```

## Between group: IQ as a covariate ##
```{r}
# IQ
y  <- subject_courses_tp[, 37]
x  <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$DX_GROUP)
z  <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$SEX)
c1 <- behaviourals_all$AGE_AT_SCAN
c2 <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$SITE_ID)

ols_iq <- lm(y ~ x + z + c1 + c2 + behaviourals_all$FIQ)       # participants with missing FIQ are dropped
ols_bs <- lm(y ~ x + z + c1 + c2 + behaviourals_all$BrainSeg)

cat("IC37 controlling for IQ:   t =", round(summary(ols_iq)$coefficients["x2", "t value"], 2),
    "| df =", ols_iq$df.residual, "| p =", signif(summary(ols_iq)$coefficients["x2", "Pr(>|t|)"], 3),
    "| N =", nobs(ols_iq), "\n")
cat("IC37 controlling for TBV:  t =", round(summary(ols_bs)$coefficients["x2", "t value"], 2),
    "| df =", ols_bs$df.residual, "| p =", signif(summary(ols_bs)$coefficients["x2", "Pr(>|t|)"], 3),
    "| N =", nobs(ols_bs), "\n")

```

## Symptom Associations: FIQ ant TBV as covariates ##
```{r}
y  <- subject_courses_ASD_matrix[, 1]
c1 <- behaviourals_ASD$AGE_AT_SCAN
c2 <- as.factor(behaviourals_ASD$SEX)
c3 <- as.factor(behaviourals_ASD$SITE_ID)

ols_total_iq <- lm(y ~ behaviourals_ASD$ADOS_2_total_gotham_harmonized + c1 + c2 + c3 + behaviourals_ASD$FIQ)
ols_css_iq   <- lm(y ~ behaviourals_ASD$ADOS_2_severity_harmonized     + c1 + c2 + c3 + behaviourals_ASD$FIQ)
ols_total_bs <- lm(y ~ behaviourals_ASD$ADOS_2_total_gotham_harmonized + c1 + c2 + c3 + behaviourals_ASD$BrainSeg)
ols_css_bs   <- lm(y ~ behaviourals_ASD$ADOS_2_severity_harmonized     + c1 + c2 + c3 + behaviourals_ASD$BrainSeg)

# p-values (row 2 = the ADOS score) and FDR across the two associations per covariate
p_iq   <- c(summary(ols_total_iq)$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"], summary(ols_css_iq)$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"])
p_bs   <- c(summary(ols_total_bs)$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"], summary(ols_css_bs)$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"])
pfdr_iq <- p.adjust(p_iq, method = "BH")
pfdr_bs <- p.adjust(p_bs, method = "BH")

cat("IC1 ADOS total controlling for IQ:   t =", round(summary(ols_total_iq)$coefficients[2, "t value"], 2),
    "| df =", ols_total_iq$df.residual, "| p =", signif(p_iq[1], 3), "| p_FDR =", signif(pfdr_iq[1], 3),
    "| N =", nobs(ols_total_iq), "\n")
cat("IC1 ADOS CSS controlling for IQ:     t =", round(summary(ols_css_iq)$coefficients[2, "t value"], 2),
    "| df =", ols_css_iq$df.residual, "| p =", signif(p_iq[2], 3), "| p_FDR =", signif(pfdr_iq[2], 3),
    "| N =", nobs(ols_css_iq), "\n")
cat("IC1 ADOS total controlling for TBV:  t =", round(summary(ols_total_bs)$coefficients[2, "t value"], 2),
    "| df =", ols_total_bs$df.residual, "| p =", signif(p_bs[1], 3), "| p_FDR =", signif(pfdr_bs[1], 3),
    "| N =", nobs(ols_total_bs), "\n")
cat("IC1 ADOS CSS controlling for TBV:    t =", round(summary(ols_css_bs)$coefficients[2, "t value"], 2),
    "| df =", ols_css_bs$df.residual, "| p =", signif(p_bs[2], 3), "| p_FDR =", signif(pfdr_bs[2], 3),
    "| N =", nobs(ols_css_bs), "\n")
```


## sex x diagnosis x age ##
```{r}
ICs <- ncol(subject_courses_tp)
pvals_3way <- matrix(NA, nrow=ICs, ncol=1)
fvals_3way <- matrix(NA, nrow=ICs, ncol=1)

# loop over ICs
for (i in 1:ICs){
  y <- subject_courses_tp[,i]
  x <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$DX_GROUP) #because categorical
  z <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$SEX) #because categorical
  c1 <- behaviourals_all$AGE_AT_SCAN #continuous
  c2 <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$SITE_ID) #because categorical

  ols <- lm(y ~ x*z*c1 + c2)
  aov3 <- Anova(ols, type="III")

  pvals_3way[i,1] <- aov3["x:z:c1", "Pr(>F)"]
  fvals_3way[i,1] <- aov3["x:z:c1", "F value"]
}

#FDR correction
pvals_3way_fdr <- p.adjust(pvals_3way[,1], method="BH")

# 3-way interaction
sig_3way <- which(pvals_3way_fdr < 0.05)
if(length(sig_3way) > 0) {
  cat("Sex x Diagnosis x Age - significant ICs:", paste0("IC", sig_3way), "\n")
} else {
  cat("No significant sex x diagnosis x age interactions\n")
}

# values for the write-up (df is correct here: this is the same model)
cat("N:", nobs(ols), "| df:", ols$df.residual, "\n")
cat("Smallest p_FDR:", min(pvals_3way_fdr), "at", paste0("IC", which.min(pvals_3way_fdr)),
    "| F:", fvals_3way[which.min(pvals_3way_fdr), 1], "\n")
```
